title: BuddhistBench grade
description: Grades for short or open items that automatic matching cannot settle, from human experts or a judge panel. One per line. 'failures' says what went wrong, so results point at the fix that would help (docs/fixes.md).

grader.description: Human handle, or 'panel:<model-a>,<model-b>,<model-c>' with exact model versions.

criteria.description: For open items: rubric criterion id -> met.

failures.description: What went wrong, if anything. Several allowed. Definitions in docs/fixes.md.
